2609.18672.title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions
2609.18672.paper_summary: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with a retriever instead. That substitution is not symmetric across the two decisions. A retriever returns its highest-scoring candidate for every input and cannot signal that the catalog holds no valid action. Our earlier study found that constraining a decoder to a tool grammar repairs malformed output without improving the choice. What the substitution costs in each decision has not been measured. We evaluate the two decisions separately over 600 Korean and English requests and a catalog of 70 local actions. The router may also ask for a missing slot, reply, or delegate. Half the in-catalog requests reuse catalog vocabulary and half paraphrase it, separating lexical overlap from the action requested. Character 3-gram BM25 selects 162 of 164 lexically matched requests and 85 of 166 paraphrases. Restricting the candidate set to seven raises the paraphrase figure to a mean of 0.825 over five trials. No classifier over its score features separates in-catalog from out-of-catalog above 0.697 area under the curve, where the frozen encoder multilingual-e5-base reaches 0.806. Using that encoder for abstention alone keeps 376 of the requests local and misroutes 9 of the 150 needing delegation. Abstention, not selection, is where a neural component is required. A neural ranker improves every quality metric and is rejected on latency and memory rather than accuracy.
2609.18672.paper_summary_zh: 一個呼叫工具的 AI 助手在每個請求上做出兩個決策：調用哪個工具，以及是否有任何可用的工具適用。在通常的設計中，單一的語言模型同時做出這兩個決策，通過發出調用或拒絕發出調用。在必須在沒有伺服器的設備上回答的情況下，語言模型使得該設計變得昂貴，主導了路由器的延遲和內存。常見的替代方案是完全移除模型，並使用檢索器對本地操作的目錄進行排名。這種替代在兩個決策上並不對稱。檢索器對每個輸入返回其得分最高的候選者，並無法發出目錄中沒有有效操作的信號。我們早期的研究發現，將解碼器限制為工具語法可以修復格式錯誤的輸出，而不改善選擇。在每個決策中的替代成本尚未被測量。我們對 600 個韓語和英語請求以及 70 個本地操作的目錄分別評估這兩個決策。路由器也可以要求缺失的槽位、回覆或委派。目錄中的一半請求重用目錄詞彙，另一半則對其進行改述，將詞彙重疊與請求的動作分開。字符 3-gram BM25 選擇了 164 個詞彙匹配請求中的 162 個和 166 個改述中的 85 個。將候選集限制為七個將改述數字提高到五次試驗的平均值 0.825。沒有任何分類器在其得分特徵上將目錄內與目錄外的請求區分開來，曲線下面積超過 0.697，而凍結的編碼器 multilingual-e5-base 達到 0.806。僅使用該編碼器進行棄權使 376 個請求保持本地，並錯誤路由 150 個需要委派的請求中的 9 個。棄權，而非選擇，是需要神經元組件的地方。神經排名器改善了每個質量指標，並在延遲和內存上被拒絕，而不是準確性。
2609.18672.author: Janghoon Lee et.al.
